tickerText:
*** BCF *** THE OUTDOORS ARE UNPREDICTABLE, RELAXING, ITCHY AND MAJESTIC. AS AUSSIES, IT'S OUR RITE OF PASSAGE TO EXPLORE THEM HOWEVER WE LIKE. WHILE SOME LIKE TO SEARCH FOR MACKIES BEFORE DAWN, OTHERS ARE ASLEEP FROM A BIG NIGHT AROUND THE CARAVAN PARK BBQ. SOME WILL CONQUER THE TRAILS WITH LITTLE MORE THAN A RUCKSACK, WHILE OTHERS PREFER WHIPPING THEIR OFFSPRING OFF A TUBE.

THAT’S WHY BCF IS HERE.

WE CAN'T DO MUCH ABOUT THE WEATHER OR THE COMPANY, BUT WE CAN EQUIP YOU SO YOU'RE A LITTLE MORE PREPARED FOR WHATEVER SPANNER THE GREAT OUTDOORS THROWS AT YOU. AND WHEN YOU'RE A LITTLE MORE PREPARED, YOU'LL HAVE A LITTLE MORE FUN.
